text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-Parliament adopts a new law giving incentives to firms who provide medical insurance for their employees.
- New ministers sworn in on Tuesday after Monday's cabinet reshuffle.
-Tunisian-Libyan joint commission started meeting in Tunis on Tuesday in talks to boost infrastructure cooperation.
- Parliament adopts law cutting firms' contribution to the social security fund.
- Last cabinet reshuffle is a new start for the country's effort for development.
- The Tunis Stock Exchange did not have a good 1996 after picking up in 1995 and 1994.
